user.title: Connect an iCloud Shared Album
user.description: Paste the public link from your iCloud Shared Album. No Apple account is required. See the [README]({readme_url}) for instructions on finding the URL.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this album, e.g. "Family Photos" or "Living Room Slideshow". Leave blank to auto-generate one.
data_description.album_url: The full link from iCloud Photos — starts with icloud.com/sharedalbum and ends with the album token after the # symbol.
data_description.scan_interval: How often (in seconds) the displayed photo rotates. Minimum 10 s.
data_description.slideshow_mode: Whether photos are shown in a random order or sequentially.
data_description.image_quality: Larger sizes look better but take longer to download.

error.invalid_url: Could not extract a token from this URL. Paste the full iCloud Shared Album link.
error.no_photos: The album appears to be empty or contains only videos.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach iCloud. Check the URL and your internet connection.
